dogecoin.text: Dogecoin’s rally marks more than double the gains of the S&P 500, including dividends, since 1988. Today has been declared "Doge Day" by the cryptocurrency's proponents, who have loosely organized a bid to push its value to $1, up from 38 cents as of 5 p.m. ET on Monday.  3/

8,000% — The approximate surge in value of the cryptocurrency dogecoin so far this year, as of Monday afternoon. The coin, which was created as a joke and designed to serve no purpose, has been propelled by memes and celebrity endorsers, such as @elonmusk and Snoop Dogg.  2/
